Title: Generally available: Azure Event Hubs Dedicated self-serve scalable clusters for mission critical Kafka, AMQP and HTTPs workloads

Body.Content:
Event Hubs Dedicated self-serve clusters are purpose-built for mission-critical event streaming workloads that demand high-volume data streaming with low-latency. These clusters are designed to provide consistent performance, cost efficiency, and self-serve scaling capabilities for Kafka, AMQP and HTTPS event streaming workloads. 

To learn more about Azure Event Hubs self-serve Dedicated clusters, please check out  Azure Event Hubs Dedicated cluster documentation.
